guides.title: Myalgic encephalomyelitis/chronic fatigue syndrome
guides.description: Low-dose naltrexone and ME/CFS: what immune-cell experiments can explain and what they do not measure.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: ME/CFS is a disabling multisystem illness marked by reduced ability to carry out usual activities, unrefreshing sleep and post-exertional malaise. Physical or mental effort can cause a delayed worsening of symptoms. Naltrexone research has examined altered signaling in natural-killer immune cells as one possible treatment target.

sentences.text: ME/CFS is a disabling multisystem illness marked by reduced ability to carry out usual activities, unrefreshing sleep and post-exertional malaise. Physical or mental effort can cause a delayed worsening of symptoms.
Naltrexone research has examined altered signaling in natural-killer immune cells as one possible treatment target.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: The cited naltrexone study investigated TRPM3 ion-channel function in cells from people with ME/CFS. It was not a randomized trial measuring recovery, work capacity or post-exertional malaise.

sentences.text: The cited naltrexone study investigated TRPM3 ion-channel function in cells from people with ME/CFS. It was not a randomized trial measuring recovery, work capacity or post-exertional malaise.

questions.question: Has this research shown that naltrexone restores daily function?
questions.answer: No controlled clinical improvement can be estimated from this cell study. Its finding concerns ion-channel behavior, leaving the size and duration of any effect on daily symptoms unanswered.

sentences.text: No controlled clinical improvement can be estimated from this cell study. Its finding concerns ion-channel behavior, leaving the size and duration of any effect on daily symptoms unanswered.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Post-exertional malaise changes how activity-based outcomes should be interpreted: doing more on one day can be followed by a symptom flare. CDC describes activity management within individual limits to reduce these episodes.

sentences.text: Post-exertional malaise changes how activity-based outcomes should be interpreted: doing more on one day can be followed by a symptom flare. CDC describes activity management within individual limits to reduce these episodes.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: A laboratory comparison of cells cannot be compared numerically with a clinical treatment trial. The practical outcomes for ME/CFS include daily function, cognitive symptoms and post-exertional worsening, not only a cellular signal.

sentences.text: A laboratory comparison of cells cannot be compared numerically with a clinical treatment trial. The practical outcomes for ME/CFS include daily function, cognitive symptoms and post-exertional worsening, not only a cellular signal.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: Patient-derived immune cells can test a channel mechanism directly. They cannot measure sleep, sustained activity or the delayed symptom worsening that defines post-exertional malaise.

sentences.text: Patient-derived immune cells can test a channel mechanism directly. They cannot measure sleep, sustained activity or the delayed symptom worsening that defines post-exertional malaise.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: The fibromyalgia and Long COVID pages discuss overlapping symptoms in distinct populations; shared fatigue does not make the diagnoses or endpoints identical.

sentences.text: The fibromyalgia and Long COVID pages discuss overlapping symptoms in distinct populations; shared fatigue does not make the diagnoses or endpoints identical.

faqs.question: Why can a one-day activity measurement miss an ME/CFS problem?
faqs.answer: Post-exertional malaise can be delayed after activity. Following symptoms over subsequent days can capture deterioration that is not obvious during the activity itself.

sentences.text: Post-exertional malaise can be delayed after activity. Following symptoms over subsequent days can capture deterioration that is not obvious during the activity itself.

guides.scope: Low-dose naltrexone and ME/CFS: what immune-cell experiments can explain and what they do not measure.

guides.title: Basal-cell carcinoma
guides.description: Itraconazole’s Hedgehog-pathway activity and early tumor changes in basal cell carcinoma.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Basal cell carcinoma begins in basal cells in the lower epidermis. It usually grows slowly but can invade surrounding tissue. Itraconazole has been studied because Hedgehog signaling is important in this cancer.

sentences.text: Basal cell carcinoma begins in basal cells in the lower epidermis. It usually grows slowly but can invade surrounding tissue. Itraconazole has been studied because Hedgehog signaling is important in this cancer.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: In an exploratory study, itraconazole reduced tumor area and markers of tumor-cell proliferation. These short-term changes do not establish durable cure or recurrence prevention.

sentences.text: In an exploratory study, itraconazole reduced tumor area and markers of tumor-cell proliferation. These short-term changes do not establish durable cure or recurrence prevention.

questions.question: How much did tumor area change?
questions.answer: Among the treated study participants, mean tumor area fell by 24% (95% CI 18.2–30.0%). The study was small and open-label.

sentences.text: Among the treated study participants, mean tumor area fell by 24% (95% CI 18.2–30.0%). The study was small and open-label.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Adverse events included moderate fatigue and a grade 4 congestive-heart-failure event, an important concern despite the small study size.

sentences.text: Adverse events included moderate fatigue and a grade 4 congestive-heart-failure event, an important concern despite the small study size.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: This study does not compare itraconazole with curative local treatment or with approved Hedgehog-pathway drugs.

sentences.text: This study does not compare itraconazole with curative local treatment or with approved Hedgehog-pathway drugs.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: Nineteen of 29 enrolled participants received itraconazole. The study measured tumor proliferation, signaling and area, not a definitive long-term cure endpoint.

sentences.text: Nineteen of 29 enrolled participants received itraconazole. The study measured tumor proliferation, signaling and area, not a definitive long-term cure endpoint.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: The melanoma page makes clear why evidence from one skin cancer cannot be assigned to another.

sentences.text: The melanoma page makes clear why evidence from one skin cancer cannot be assigned to another.

faqs.question: Is basal cell carcinoma the same as melanoma?
faqs.answer: No. Basal cell carcinoma arises from basal cells, while melanoma develops from melanocytes. Their biology and treatment evidence are different.

sentences.text: No. Basal cell carcinoma arises from basal cells, while melanoma develops from melanocytes. Their biology and treatment evidence are different.

guides.scope: Itraconazole’s Hedgehog-pathway activity and early tumor changes in basal cell carcinoma.

guides.title: Multiple myeloma
guides.description: Thalidomide’s transition to an established myeloma treatment and its distinctive safety risks.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Multiple myeloma is a cancer of plasma cells in the bone marrow. It can damage bone and interfere with healthy blood-cell production. Thalidomide is an example of repurposing that reached an approved cancer indication.

sentences.text: Multiple myeloma is a cancer of plasma cells in the bone marrow. It can damage bone and interfere with healthy blood-cell production. Thalidomide is an example of repurposing that reached an approved cancer indication.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: Thalidomide with dexamethasone is FDA-approved for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma. Its status differs from exploratory repurposing candidates supported only by laboratory or small early clinical studies.

sentences.text: Thalidomide with dexamethasone is FDA-approved for newly diagnosed multiple myeloma. Its status differs from exploratory repurposing candidates supported only by laboratory or small early clinical studies.

questions.question: Is thalidomide an investigational myeloma treatment?
questions.answer: Its combination with dexamethasone has an established approved indication. The appropriate regimen still depends on the patient’s disease and treatment context.

sentences.text: Its combination with dexamethasone has an established approved indication. The appropriate regimen still depends on the patient’s disease and treatment context.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Thalidomide can cause severe birth defects and blood clots. Nerve damage is another clinically important risk of this drug class; these hazards are integral to treatment selection and monitoring.

sentences.text: Thalidomide can cause severe birth defects and blood clots. Nerve damage is another clinically important risk of this drug class; these hazards are integral to treatment selection and monitoring.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: Thalidomide belongs to the same broad immunomodulatory treatment family as lenalidomide and pomalidomide. They are distinct medicines and are not interchangeable solely because they share that category.

sentences.text: Thalidomide belongs to the same broad immunomodulatory treatment family as lenalidomide and pomalidomide. They are distinct medicines and are not interchangeable solely because they share that category.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: FDA approval of thalidomide with dexamethasone represents an established myeloma indication. The relevant evidence question is the benefit and harm of the particular combination and treatment setting.

sentences.text: FDA approval of thalidomide with dexamethasone represents an established myeloma indication. The relevant evidence question is the benefit and harm of the particular combination and treatment setting.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: The thalidomide profile follows the repurposing history, approved combination and distinctive immune effects.

sentences.text: The thalidomide profile follows the repurposing history, approved combination and distinctive immune effects.

faqs.question: Why can myeloma cause bone and blood problems?
faqs.answer: Abnormal plasma cells accumulate in bone marrow, interfering with normal blood-cell production and contributing to bone damage.

sentences.text: Abnormal plasma cells accumulate in bone marrow, interfering with normal blood-cell production and contributing to bone damage.

guides.scope: Thalidomide’s transition to an established myeloma treatment and its distinctive safety risks.

guides.title: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
guides.description: The harmful functional outcome in the phase III minocycline trial for ALS.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis damages the motor neurons that control voluntary muscles. Progressive weakness can affect movement, speech, swallowing and breathing.

sentences.text: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis damages the motor neurons that control voluntary muscles. Progressive weakness can affect movement, speech, swallowing and breathing.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: Minocycline accelerated functional decline in a 412-person ALS trial. The study provides direct evidence against the hoped-for neuroprotective benefit in this population.

sentences.text: Minocycline accelerated functional decline in a 412-person ALS trial. The study provides direct evidence against the hoped-for neuroprotective benefit in this population.

questions.question: How much faster was decline?
questions.answer: ALSFRS-R scores fell by 1.30 points per month with minocycline versus 1.04 with placebo; the difference was statistically significant (P=0.005).

sentences.text: ALSFRS-R scores fell by 1.30 points per month with minocycline versus 1.04 with placebo; the difference was statistically significant (P=0.005).

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Gastrointestinal and neurological adverse events were more common with minocycline. The faster functional decline itself was the most consequential unfavorable finding.

sentences.text: Gastrointestinal and neurological adverse events were more common with minocycline. The faster functional decline itself was the most consequential unfavorable finding.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: The placebo-controlled clinical result outweighs the earlier animal-model promise for this ALS regimen. Mortality was numerically higher, but that difference was not statistically significant.

sentences.text: The placebo-controlled clinical result outweighs the earlier animal-model promise for this ALS regimen. Mortality was numerically higher, but that difference was not statistically significant.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: After a four-month lead-in, participants received randomized treatment for nine months. The primary endpoint measured the monthly rate of functional loss, rather than an isolated laboratory marker.

sentences.text: After a four-month lead-in, participants received randomized treatment for nine months. The primary endpoint measured the monthly rate of functional loss, rather than an isolated laboratory marker.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: The minocycline profile brings together its antimicrobial use and the condition-specific results of repurposing trials.

sentences.text: The minocycline profile brings together its antimicrobial use and the condition-specific results of repurposing trials.

faqs.question: Why are breathing and swallowing outcomes important in ALS?
faqs.answer: ALS can weaken muscles involved in respiration and swallowing as well as the limbs. These functions affect health, communication and daily support needs.

sentences.text: ALS can weaken muscles involved in respiration and swallowing as well as the limbs. These functions affect health, communication and daily support needs.

guides.scope: The harmful functional outcome in the phase III minocycline trial for ALS.

protectedVitiligo.title: Vitiligo
protectedVitiligo.description: Atorvastatin’s immune rationale and its unsuccessful addition to narrowband UV-B for active vitiligo.

sections.label: Overview
sections.paragraph: Vitiligo causes loss of pigment when melanocytes are destroyed or stop functioning. Autoimmune processes are important in the disease, and visible skin changes can substantially affect quality of life.

sentences.text: Vitiligo causes loss of pigment when melanocytes are destroyed or stop functioning. Autoimmune processes are important in the disease, and visible skin changes can substantially affect quality of life.

sections.label: Options
sections.paragraph: A small randomized trial did not find that adding atorvastatin improved the effect of narrowband UV-B phototherapy on active nonsegmental vitiligo.

sentences.text: A small randomized trial did not find that adding atorvastatin improved the effect of narrowband UV-B phototherapy on active nonsegmental vitiligo.

questions.question: Did both treatment groups improve?
questions.answer: Yes. Vitiligo scores improved in both groups, but the between-group VASI difference was not significant (P=0.49). Improvement during combined treatment therefore cannot be assigned to atorvastatin.

sentences.text: Yes. Vitiligo scores improved in both groups, but the between-group VASI difference was not significant (P=0.49). Improvement during combined treatment therefore cannot be assigned to atorvastatin.

sections.label: Safety
sections.paragraph: Ten participants receiving atorvastatin reported adverse events, including muscle pain and gastrointestinal symptoms. One developed a transient muscle-enzyme elevation that resolved after dose reduction.

sentences.text: Ten participants receiving atorvastatin reported adverse events, including muscle pain and gastrointestinal symptoms. One developed a transient muscle-enzyme elevation that resolved after dose reduction.

sections.label: Comparisons
sections.paragraph: The direct comparison was atorvastatin plus phototherapy versus the same phototherapy alone over six months. It did not establish extra benefit from atorvastatin.

sentences.text: The direct comparison was atorvastatin plus phototherapy versus the same phototherapy alone over six months. It did not establish extra benefit from atorvastatin.

sections.label: Evidence
sections.paragraph: Thirty participants were randomized and 29 were analyzed. The study assessed both vitiligo area and spreading; neither showed a significant added effect of atorvastatin.

sentences.text: Thirty participants were randomized and 29 were analyzed. The study assessed both vitiligo area and spreading; neither showed a significant added effect of atorvastatin.

sections.label: Connections
sections.paragraph: The atorvastatin profile explains its original lipid action and the additional immune hypotheses examined in vitiligo.

sentences.text: The atorvastatin profile explains its original lipid action and the additional immune hypotheses examined in vitiligo.

faqs.question: Can vitiligo affect hair as well as skin?
faqs.answer: Yes. Loss of melanocyte function can cause hair in affected areas to turn white; mucous membranes may also lose pigment.

sentences.text: Yes. Loss of melanocyte function can cause hair in affected areas to turn white; mucous membranes may also lose pigment.
